capabilities: Mark notes for repetition with a repeat property or command
Schedule reviews with periodic intervals (daily, weekly, every 3 days) or spaced multipliers
Review due notes in a dedicated Repeat view with schedule buttons
Filter due notes by tags or Dataview source expressions and save filters
Hide note bodies during reviews and bias reviews toward the evening
extras: All repetition state (repeat, due_at, hidden) lives in the note's frontmatter and can be edited manually; the author links an external obsidian-scripts repo for bulk-adding repeat properties.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring notes back for review on a fixed or expanding schedule.

relations.evidence: Install Dataview and Repeat Plugin from Community Plugins

summary: Spaced and periodic repetition reviewer that schedules notes via a repeat property and shows due notes in a dedicated Repeat view.
